timezoneNote: All times use this PC's local clock.

claude.comment: Leave bin empty to auto-find the Claude CLI (PATH, ~/.local/bin, or the desktop app's bundled copy, newest version first).

codex.comment: Local ChatGPT-signed-in Codex CLI backs up new HQ chats and queued missions while Claude is limited. Deep uses Astra only when requested.

autonomy.comment: Ceiling for every mission and the chat: read < plan < build. A project's maxPermission can lower it further, never raise it.

budget.comment: Chat messages don't count toward maxRunsPerDay. Hitting the cap leaves missions queued until tomorrow.

usageLimit.comment: When Claude says the usage limit is hit, HQ pauses until the reset time it reports, or this many minutes if it can't read one, then resumes the same session.

keepAwakeComment: busy = keep the PC awake while missions are queued or running; always = whenever HQ runs (best for multi-day autonomy); off = never.

ntfy.comment: detail: title = only the headline goes to your phone; full = headline + body. The private topic name lives in config/hq.local.json.

assistant.name: LUTHUR
assistant.persona: Calm, precise, quietly witty chief of staff. Anticipates what the owner needs, flags risks early, keeps answers short enough to be read aloud.
assistant.comment: Rename or restyle the assistant here. Voice input/output is in the dashboard (Assistant screen).

tasks.comment: How many delegated tasks / sub-agents (and manual runs) may run at once. Scheduled missions use one extra lane. Two runs never work on the same project at the same time. An approved task runs to the end without asking, up to maxSubtasks agents and maxTaskMinutes of agent time in total.

debrief.comment: Evening debrief (src/lib/debrief.ts): at this hour LUTHUR writes what it did today, what waits for you and what is due tomorrow (no AI cost), shows it on Today and sends one phone alert, only when something happened.

verify.comment: Verify-before-done (src/lib/verify.ts). After a build run on a project with folders, HQ compares the folders before and after, runs the project's checks when files changed, and compares the agent's report with the real changes. A failed check or mismatch marks it 'needs a look'. checks: { "<project slug>": ["command", ...] } overrides what HQ finds (npm test, pytest in venv/.venv); [] turns checks off for that project.

code.comment: Code screen: how many sessions may run at once, and the time limit per message.

watch.comment: Email/calendar watcher (src/lib/watch.ts): Needs-you cards for important or action-looking unread email (needs the Inbox turned on) and new/moved/cancelled/clashing events in the next 7 days. Code only, no model calls. phoneMail=false keeps email cards off your phone.
